name: opffk · OpenFlux Exit Node
description: Веб-панель управления OpenFlux exit node на Keenetic/Entware: транспорты, ключи, обновления и откат ядра.

hints: ARM64 / ARMv7; MIPS and MIPSEL are not supported by upstream binaries
128 MB available RAM minimum (256 MB recommended)
Web UI binds to the router LAN IP by default

notes: Upstream installer downloads and verifies opffk/OpenFlux binaries, creates service account and starts the service.
Installation executes upstream code; RouterForge displays instructions only and does not execute it automatically.
External connectivity of the exit node requires a separate owner-configured port forward.
